value.rationale: The main recently established theorem gives universal existence, whereas the new result completely counts ordered DLDS partitions on a canonical infinite graph class and identifies a sharp exceptional one-nonsingleton case. The simultaneous two-LD enumeration resolves the natural stronger question for every complete multipartite graph, including graphs with twins, with exact counts and balanced cardinalities. Both are natural, motivated invariants beyond textbook deductions from existence; these exact counts determine enumeration/sampling possibilities for the class.
